newsitem.title: USA: U.S. seeks best bids Thurs in round 2 of SPR sale.
newsitem.headline: U.S. seeks best bids Thurs in round 2 of SPR sale.

text.p: The U.S. Energy Department plans to award sales, if any, Thursday in the second round of its auction of oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, an Energy Department official said Tuesday.
Best and final offers are due Thursday at 1300 EDT/1800 GMT, he said.
The government is in the process of selling sour crude from the emergency stockpile to raise $220 million to help trim the federal budget gap.
In the first round last week, it raised $33 million, selling 1.1 million barrels of sour crude and all 370,000 barrels of the sweet crude on offer.
